entries.content: The original teams are disbanded into a "boys vs. girls" team challenge.

entries.name: Team Composition
entries.content: The twenty-two campers were divided into two teams of eleven.

entries.name: Merge Composition
entries.content: There will be twelve campers who are part of the merge, ten who are still competing, and two returnees.

entries.name: Return
entries.content: Two previously eliminated contestants will return at the merge.

entries.name: Elimination Challenge
entries.content: During the final nine, the contestants will face a sudden death challenge where the last contestant to lose is automatically eliminated and will automatically be sent to the Boat of Losers.

entries.name: Eliminated Contestants Vote
entries.content: During the final five, the eliminated contestants are given the opportunity to vote out one of the remaining contestants.

entries.name: Final Challenge
entries.content: Instead of a final elimination ceremony, where the eliminated contestants would vote for a winner, a Final Challenge is held with the final two contestants, with the first to cross the finish line winning the prize money.

entries.name: Individual Start
entries.content: The first two challenges are completely individual.

entries.name: Double Elimination
entries.content: The contestants have to vote out two competitors, instead of the usual one, on occasion.

entries.name: Saboteur
entries.content: A previously eliminated contestant returns for the chance to earn money by sabotaging the competitors during the merge phase.

entries.name: Finalist Helpers/Hinderers
entries.content: In the final challenge, the two finalists are each given an eliminated contestant to act as their helper. Midway through the challenge, the two helpers became hinderers, working against the finalists with the opportunity to split the money between themselves if neither finalist completed the challenge.
